bundle.shortDescription: Inspect ROCm profiling traces and GPU kernel behavior.
bundle.longDescription: A local Rust and Tauri workspace for ROCm trace, occupancy, source, instruction and counter analysis. Raw ATT decoding requires Python, ROCm disassembly tools and the native decoder V2 library.
